root_cause: Caddy sorts bare directives (handle before respond); file_server answered before the 401 respond. Repo Caddyfile had this ordering.
fix: deploy/collector/Caddyfile: method gate, token gate and path handles wrapped in route { } to preserve literal order.

tests.method: real caddy:2.8-alpine container started from the repo Caddyfile with a test token; requests via docker exec wget
tests.negative_control: with the previous (pre-fix) Caddyfile, 3 auth tests fail (unauthenticated requests got 200), proving the test detects the ordering bug

readme: deploy/collector/README.md documents `docker compose up -d --force-recreate bundle-server` after Caddyfile edits (single-file bind mount keeps old inode).

live_host_replacement.note: This worker has no access to the collector host. Operator must: copy the delivered Caddyfile over the temporary route{} version (keep Caddyfile.repo backup until verified), run `docker compose up -d --force-recreate bundle-server`, then re-check 401/401/200/404/405 and record results here.
